clock: one shared parent experiment active-session wall clock
children_and_retries: all child and retry intervals remain inside this same unreset clock; overlap is counted once
interruption: no time was subtracted for the user interruption/resumption
limits: Concurrent aggregate model compute/agent seconds are not observable and are not inferred. No resource-efficiency claim. The clock measures bounded active-session qualification, not compute consumption. Independent Chief of Staff resolves the existing clock-definition ambiguity; no code, acceptance threshold or workload changed.
